About.metaDescription: Brami (Brami Trade) grows saffron in Bulgaria and makes Saffron Adela Sunny natural cosmetics – the first Bulgarian line of hair and body wash products with saffron.
About.ogDescription: Brami combines natural ingredients, soft textures and a clean visual language for quality everyday care.
storyParagraphs: It all started with our decision to grow saffron in Bulgaria. Fascinated by its properties, we wanted to bring something different to the market – something that was missing at the time. That is how the Saffron Adela Sunny cosmetics line was born, starting with hair and body wash products with saffron. The name evokes the sunny, golden colour saffron gives when dissolved, its absolute purity and the remarkable strength with which this delicate flower proudly rises to bloom on cool autumn days.

Our research in 2019–2021 confirmed that there were no hair and body wash products with saffron (Crocus sativus) created and made in Bulgaria by Bulgarians. As pioneers in hair and body care with Crocus sativus, we built this market segment from scratch. Our saffron shampoo became the undisputed leader of our brand's range. Our greatest reward is the hundreds of reviews we receive. Customers say the shampoo stops hair loss, eliminates dandruff and helps with scalp problems. They describe the effect in their own words: “It fills my hair with life” and “It feels like I've just been to the hairdresser”. This gave us reason to create the hair conditioner as well, which rounds off the idea of natural, uncomplicated care with lasting results.
The philosophy that drives us forward is that with Bulgarian inspiration and courage you can be an innovator and create cosmetics with clear market results and customer recognition.
Thank you for your feedback and your trust!
About.signature: With love, Rumyana Brankova and Brami Trade
About.title: Bulgarian care, inspired by nature
About.lead: Brami combines carefully selected ingredients, a soft feel on the skin and a clean visual language. We create products that bring a sense of care, calm and everyday comfort.

About.approachTitle: Formulas focused on effectiveness and a gentle feel
approachParagraphs: We believe good cosmetics should be pleasant to use and have clearly stated ingredients. That is why we pay close attention to texture, fragrance and how the skin feels after every use.
We select active and natural ingredients so that the products fit easily into your everyday face, body and hair care.
About.brandTitle: Care that looks premium and stays close to nature
brandParagraphs: For us, a product's beauty is not only in how it looks. It is also in how it feels on the skin, in the purity of the formula and in the trust it builds with every use.
We are building Brami as a brand with a clear character: soft aesthetics, carefully chosen ingredients and products that feel high-quality from the very first touch.
